title: sutra_constraints bug
description: One thing for you as sutra's maintainer: after reparse, sutra_deps cycles=true correctly returns zero, but sutra_constraints action=violations still lists the no-module-cycles constraint (id 22f0f35d) as a degenerate empty-path row — from_path:"", to_path:"", detail:"import cycle: ". It looks like the violations endpoint leaves a stale constraint shell once the backing edge disappears, instead of dropping it. It'd give a false "blocking" in a release-review even though nothing's wrong. Ground truth (sutra_deps) is fine; the constraints projection is the buggy side. Noted in the task record too. from swisseph-rs/91
execution_record: Added a guard in evaluate_dd's cycle detection loop: skip when cycle_paths.len() < cycle.file_ids.len() (any unresolved file_id means stale engine data). Initially tried cycle_paths.is_empty() but the test revealed that partial ID overlap (autoincrement collisions between stale engine IDs and fresh DB IDs) could produce bogus cycles with wrong paths — the len comparison catches both cases.
root_cause: Race window between parse_workspace DB commit and engine.invalidate() in the add_root background task. replace_file_data deletes and re-inserts file records with new autoincrement IDs, so the DD engine's stale cycle file_ids don't exist in the freshly-read path_map. The cycle detection loop unconditionally pushed a ConstraintFinding even when cycle_paths was empty (all filter_map lookups failed), and match_no_cycles_constraint matched vacuously on the empty slice (.all() over empty → true).

messages.author: codex
messages.text:
Codex review: approve with notes.

Fix correctly guards against the observed bug (unresolvable file_ids → degenerate empty-path findings). Test covers that scenario.

One finding (pre-existing, not introduced by this fix): stale engine cycles where all file_ids still resolve but the backing import edges no longer form a cycle would still produce false findings. This requires engine staleness where files keep their IDs but imports change — the normal upsert_file path. Worth tracking as a separate hardening task (force DD engine reload or validate reported SCCs against current edges before emitting findings).
